Case A: A medicine's current labeling requires a condition outside the pharmacy's general refrigerator or freezer ranges, but staff use the general range without checking the product.

Case B: A pharmacy stores medication in a dorm-style refrigerator with a small freezer compartment inside the refrigerator and also keeps staff meals there.

Which proposed interpretation is INCORRECT? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Equipment capacity, airflow, monitoring, and maintenance matter to storage suitability.
A.original_rationale_ko: 옳은 설명이므로 오류 선택의 정답이 아님. 냉각 감각이나 외관으로 환경 적합성을 증명하지 않는다.

B.original_option_text: The actual product's approved storage and stability requirements must be considered rather than replaced by a general range.
B.original_rationale_ko: 옳은 설명이므로 오류 선택의 정답이 아님. 일반 냉장2–8°C·냉동 범위와 개별 제품 조건을 구별한다.

C.original_option_text: Unopened manufacturer expiration applies unchanged after every reconstitution or opening.
C.original_rationale_ko:
오류를 고르는 문항의 정답. 실제 처리 상태의 별도 in-use·BUD·expiry를 확인한다.

D.original_option_text: The described dorm-style equipment and food storage do not meet the stated medication-storage conditions.

Case A: A pharmacy checks and records its medication temperature only once per day, though the described Board policy calls for two reviews and records daily.

Case B: After an excursion, the unit returns to normal temperature and staff release quarantined products without evaluating exposure duration or stability evidence.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Normal current temperature proves the prior excursion caused no product problem.
A.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 최고·최저·지속시간·반복 노출·manufacturer 근거·disposition을 검토한다.

B.original_option_text: A closed pharmacy has no need to detect out-of-range storage on those days.

교정된 설명: The described temperature and excursion records have a minimum one-year retention requirement.

D.original_option_text: The one-check schedule does not meet the described twice-daily review-and-record structure.
D.original_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. 해당 온도 검토·기록 주기를 그대로 적용한다.

Case A: A delivery invoice is present, but the incoming package has damaged seals and an unresolved temperature history.

Case B: The pharmacy plans to mail a lawful prescription using packaging that will freeze a temperature-sensitive medicine against a cold pack.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: A lawful dispensing automatically makes every chosen mailing method permissible.
A.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. USPS authorized mailer·포장·배송과 pharmacy dispensing authority를 구분한다.
교정된 설명: Authorized mailing conditions and lawful dispensing conditions must both be evaluated.

B.original_option_text: A valid prescription makes medication-stability protection during shipping unnecessary.
B.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 적법한 Rx와 안전한 포장·운송은 별도 요건이다.
교정된 설명: Packaging and transport must protect the medicine's actual integrity and stability.

C.original_option_text: An invoice does not establish that a damaged or temperature-exposed product is usable.
C.original_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. Supplier·거래 증빙과 실제 product quality를 각각 확인한다.

D.original_option_text: Using a common carrier transfers every quality obligation away from the pharmacy.
D.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 위탁 이후에도 해당 pharmacy 책임과 P&P를 유지한다.
교정된 설명: Contracting with a carrier does not eliminate all pharmacy product-quality responsibility.
